title: InstallationPlan
description: InstallationPlan document, kind installation_plan (CF12, CF13, 8.1; normative rules in docs/installation-plan.md). The document is a hashed structure: readers parse it with the hashing restrictions of docs/canonical-json.md and plan_id is the value of its top-level `hash`, which is always present and always equal to object_hash(document) recomputed by the reader (HASH_MISMATCH otherwise). Unknown members are rejected at every level: a member a reader does not know can be neither displayed nor consented to, so any new member needs a new schema_version. The plan is a deterministic function of the probed host state, the client version and the bundled contracts: it contains no timestamps, random ids or operation ids, so that rebuilding it for an unchanged host yields the same plan_id. Every element of steps[] is an ACTION, in execution order; read-only checks are not listed (plan_action_count = number of steps). This schema checks structure only; the semantic rules (closed step-kind vocabulary of registry/plan-step-kinds.json, privilege and flag consistency, required and forbidden step members, official sources, image rules, title templates, licence references, disk estimate) are listed in docs/installation-plan.md and implemented by tools/validate.py.

platform.description: windows: Sprut Desktop (WSL2 + Sprut distribution); linux: sprut CLI on Ubuntu.

current_state.description: Summary of the probed host state the plan starts from.

target_state.description: Summary of the host state after all steps succeeded.

images.description: Every image the plan uses, pulled or run, as ImageReference; at most one entry per digest. An image without an image_pull step must already be present by digest (guard image_present_by_digest).

licences.description: Licence terms of third-party components installed by the plan. Never accepted on the user's behalf: each one needs its own explicit acceptance before consent (CF13; CLI --accept-license <id>).

docker_access.description: Linux only, required there: how the user gets access to Docker Engine (spec 7.4 item 3). docker_group: the plan adds the user to the docker group (step add_user_to_docker_group with a separate acknowledgement) unless already a member. none: no group change; Sprut never runs engine operations through sudo by itself, so bootstrap stops at ENGINE_CHECK with ENGINE_PERMISSION_DENIED (ACTION_REQUIRED) until the user grants access. Rules: DOCKER_ACCESS_MISMATCH.

disk_estimate_bytes.description: Disk space the plan needs: the sum of estimated_bytes of all steps.

hash.description: plan_id = object_hash of this document (docs/canonical-json.md section 2).

wsl.description: Windows only. A wsl_availability state for which a plan exists.

docker_group.description: Linux only: membership of the current user in the docker group.

worker_image.description: All images of images[] present locally by digest, or not.

id.description: Unique within the plan (DUPLICATE_STEP_ID). Used by the executor, the elevated helper and OperationEvent progress.step.

title.description: Exactly the title template of the kind, rendered (only {repository} for image_pull). Never free text from the host or a subprocess.

privileged.description: Host elevation (UAC / sudo); must equal the registry value for the kind on the plan's platform.

estimated_bytes.description: Additional disk space the step needs (downloads kept, installed files, image layers).

image.description: image_pull only: the image to pull; must be listed in images[].

wslconfig.description: write_wslconfig only: managed [wsl2] values to write.

wslconfig_file.description: write_wslconfig only: the .wslconfig state the plan was built from (CR03). sha256: SHA-256 of the current file bytes, or `absent`. replaced: the current values, as text from the file, of the managed keys this step overwrites (at most the keys of `wslconfig`; empty when the file is absent). A current value that is not representable as display text (control or invisible characters, more than 256 code points) is never put here: the probe reports WSL_CONFIG_CONFLICT for that key and no plan is built (docs/wsl-resources.md). Both are shown to the user and bound by plan_id.

distro.description: unregister_distro only: the distribution that will be removed, shown to the user. name: registered name; base_path: its registered BasePath; vhdx_bytes: size of its virtual disk (data that will be lost).

base_path.description: Registered BasePath, up to the Windows long-path limit of 32767 UTF-16 units (at most 32767 code points here).

target_user.description: add_user_to_docker_group only: the user that gets docker access, from the uid of the client process (never from environment variables such as USER or SUDO_USER). root (uid 0) is never a target.

name.description: Login name as reported for the uid; never starts with '-' (it becomes a command argument).

licence_ids.description: Licences of licences[] that apply to what this step installs.

source.description: Official source of a downloaded artifact and its integrity: url must start with one of the kind's source_url_prefixes; sha256 is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the downloaded bytes, checked before use (INTEGRITY_MISMATCH otherwise).

https_url.description: https URL with a lowercase host, no port, no userinfo, no query or fragment; path segments never start with `.` (no `..`) and contain no percent-encoding.

licence.description: Licence terms. The client ships the text (pinned by sha256, the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the text it displays) and shows it; url is the reference location.

image_reference.description: ImageReference: `<repository>@<ImageDigest>`, the only form passed to the engine. Its digest part is the identity used by the allowlist and the consented plan.

wslconfig_wsl2.description: Managed keys of the [wsl2] section of .wslconfig (CR01, CR02); at least one. memory: VM memory, a positive whole number of MB or GB. processors: logical processors, 1-1024. swap: swap file size, `0` disables swap, otherwise a positive whole number of MB or GB. networkingMode: only `nat` (mirrored is planned for node mode and stays refused until S2 decides Q14). No other .wslconfig key is managed.

disk_size.description: Maximum virtual disk size of the Sprut distribution: a positive whole number of GB or TB. Never applied to other distributions and never through .wslconfig defaultVhdSize (that key is global and not managed).
